optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system performance.
Review AI system's configuration and logs to ensure it is properly integrated and functioning.
Assess and potentially adjust trading strategies to ensure they are actively engaging in trades.

recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and affect the platform's ability to process trades efficiently.
